QuestInfo.name: To Fenelle
QuestInfo.1: Tell #p3000001# about the Transcendents. #p3000001# is at #m400000001#.
QuestInfo.2: After your discussion with #p3000001#, you've learned that the Interdimensional Portal is opened when one of the other Transcendents use the powers of the Transcendent of Time. The Interdimensional Portal that just opened must have been caused by the Black Mage. His seal must have broken! #p3000001# is going to let the alliance know about this.

yes.0: #p3000001# might already know about all this, but we should probably talk it over before my brain pops. #p3000001# is at #m400000001#. Off I go!

no.0: I think I need to organize this a little more.

1.0: Greetings, Kaiser.\r\n#L0##bHey, did you get that huge document on the Transcendents from Maple World?#l\n#k
1.1: Yes. The big takeaway was how something strange seems to happen when Transcendents use each others' powers.\r\n#L0##bYeah. Stealing the Transcendent of Time's power seems to be the big one.#l\n#k
1.2: When Darmoor confined Chronica and used Chronica's power, the Interdimensional Portals began appearing all across Grandis. One of those also appeared here at #m400000001#. And Magnus disappeared from Maple World when the Black Mage took Rhinne's power, right?\r\n#L0##bSo, the Interdimensional Portals appear when other Transcendents uses the power of the Transcendent of Time?#l\n#k
1.3: I believe that is the case. Maybe Magnus returned to this place through the Interdimensional Portal created when the Black Mage used Rhinne's power. That might also account for the time gap between him leaving Maple World and arriving here.\r\n#L0##bBut...they didn't find the Interdimensional Portal on Maple World until now.#l\n#k
1.4: That must be because that power was sealed along with the Black M...oh. Oh, no.\r\n#L0##bHm? What is it?#l\n#k
1.5: If...if the Interdimensional Portal has appeared just now on Maple World...\r\n#L0##b...The seal on the Black Mage has been broken!?#l\n#k
1.6: That's the only explanation I can think of. I don't know how it broke, but you can't explain the portal otherwise. We have to let the Alliance know about this.

yes.0: I guess things have gotten a lot more serious than we expected. Maple World is facing the return of their biggest threat, and we're preparing to attack ours. I better get ready to dish out some serious beatdowns.
